C035.about: Lobby screen: slot table with colour and ready, nation and colour picker, read-only settings, chat, host controls (kick, close, AI, Start), the joiner's view and a refusal for different rules.

shots.caption: Host's lobby: Host, Friend A and Friend B seated, one open slot (AI or Close), nobody ready; Start is off and says who it waits for. Settings are read-only on the left, chat on the right.

Everybody is ready: all three show Ready with their nation and colour, the chat holds both lines, Start game is on.
Friend A's view: own seat marked (you), the host marked, the same settings read-only, no Kick, Close or Start; only Ready, Pick nation and chat.
A joiner whose rules differ from the host's is refused with a plain sentence about base ruleset and mods; nothing else is shown and no seat is taken.
After the host kicked Friend B and closed the slot: slot 3 is Closed (Open undoes it), slot 4 is still Open and becomes AI at Start.

C036.about: Multiplayer turn bar: who has ended, deadline countdown, connection marks, Next turn / Undo end turn, resolving overlay and toasts for other humans' actions.

shots.caption: Turn bar under the buttons: 'Waiting for Alice, Bob', countdown 1:05, both players green and Playing; Next turn and Next unit bottom right.
Alice (you) has ended (green Ended) and the button reads Undo end turn; the bar says 'Waiting for Bob (offline)' with Bob's dot red.
After Undo, Bob ends his turn: his row turns Ended, the bar says 'Waiting for Alice' and a toast reads 'Bob ended their turn'.
Both ended and the host is resolving: dimmed 'Resolving the turn / Waiting for the host' overlay, disabled 'Resolving turn...' button, and the refusal in the status line.

C045.about: In-game players and chat panel of a hosted game, host view: chat, host-only Kick and Rebind.

shots.caption: The Players panel, top right: Alice (you) and Bob with green dots and 'Online'; only Bob's row has Kick and Rebind; the chat below is empty.
Two chat lines, 'Bob: Hello Alice!' and 'Alice: Hi Bob, ready when you are'; the sender is the name the host stamped.

C006.about: Join screen (address or invite, password, known hosts), fingerprint prompt, host-key-changed hard stop and the reconnect overlay.

shots.caption: The join screen as it opens: an address-or-invite field, a password field, Join and Back; no known hosts yet.
First time at an address: the host's key fingerprint is shown with the advice to continue only if the host told you that fingerprint; nothing has been sent yet.
After trusting, the host refused the wrong password with a plain sentence; the address is now listed under known hosts with Forget.
The host's key differs from the pinned one: a hard stop explaining what it may mean and that nothing was sent; only Back and Forget the old key.
Connection lost: the game is covered by a panel saying it retries with the same key and keeps commands; no buttons.

The top bar with the pack's stat icons (gold, science, culture, happiness, faith, golden age).

C065.about: Shared UI components in every state: icon buttons with badges, steppers, segmented control, stat chips and bars, inline stat icons, key hints, underline tab bar with overflow arrows, list rows, data table and empty state. The tab bar of every screen now uses underline tabs.

shots.caption: Control components: a close icon button, a bell with a red count badge, a disabled undo button and a gold Next unit button with a count badge; two steppers (the second at its minimum, so its minus is dimmed); a segmented control with Medium chosen; stat chips with green +5, red -2 and muted 0 deltas; a thin and a labelled stat bar with captions; inline stat icons; T and Esc key hints; a tab bar that shows scroll arrows because its tabs do not fit.

List rows (Warrior selected with the accent bar, Settler, and a greyed Galleon showing Requires Navigation), a data table with right-aligned City, Pop and Net columns and zebra rows, and an empty state with its Save game action.
The same components at 1280x720: the control page on the left and the data page on the right.

C066.about: One frame for every popup and screen: Modal (scrim, centred panel with the brass hairline on its top edge, title, body and a right-aligned footer with the primary button right-most, stacked when there are more than three), ScreenFrame (header bar with hairline, title, close button, content, footer) and a styled tooltip that wraps at 340 px and never covers the HUD top bar. The alert, decision-picker, tutorial, trade-proposal, rename and hotseat popups now all use Modal.

shots.caption: A popup in the shared Modal frame over the scrim: brass hairline along the panel's top edge, the title, the body, and the footer with Cancel (secondary) left of OK (primary, gold).
A destructive confirmation: the consequence line, Cancel (secondary) on the left and Declare war (danger, red text and border) on the right; Escape chooses Cancel.

The tooltip: a raised Surface3 panel with border and shadow, as wide as its longest line.
Rome's demand in a Modal: Decide later (ghost) on the left, Refuse (secondary), Accept (primary, right-most); Escape does the same as Decide later.
Rome's peace proposal in a Modal: four answers stacked in a column (Accept primary, two secondary, Decide later ghost) because there are more than three.
A decision picker in the Modal frame: title, prompt, the option column, the reason Confirm is disabled in red, and Decide later (ghost) and Choose (primary, disabled) in the footer.
A tutorial step in the Modal frame: title, text, the 2 / 3 counter and OK (primary); Escape dismisses it like OK.
The rename popup in the Modal frame: the name field, the refusal reason in the lightened danger red, Cancel and a disabled OK.
The hotseat hand-over: an opaque scrim with the same Modal frame, the next player's name and Ready (primary).
The tile tooltip in the new tooltip style, wrapped to the 340 px maximum and placed below the HUD top bar instead of over it.

1280x720 (Regular) after resizing the window: the same structure with the Policies pill in full, the 200x140 minimap and the unit panel at the bottom left.
The notification column with its drop-down list open under the toggle, floating over the map and the docks.
